title: The GNS image as a type II$_1$ subfactor
html:
Remark. The GNS image as a type II_1 subfactor

Remark. The image M := \pi_{\mathrm{GNS}}(H_\infty(q))'' forms a finite type II_1 von Neumann algebra. This realizes the Jones–Wenzl subfactor planar algebra. The subfactor theory machinery applies directly to the QOU algebraic data. This establishes clause 1 of the CFS comparison summary.
